title: Assistive Partner Accesses Best Practices, FAQs, and Knowledge Base - Functional Test Plan
overview: Comprehensive functional testing of the Help & Resources feature on the Y4J AT/AD Vendor Portal. Covers navigation and access via top navigation bar, search bar functionality (keyword search, suggested keywords, filtered results), category tabs (Categories, FAQs, Contact), Categories view (Best Practices, Product Management, GenAI Features, Compliance & Approvals cards with article counts, expandable article lists), FAQs view (collapsible/expandable FAQ items by category), Contact view (Email Support, Phone Support), unified search across all resources with categorized results, and error handling (no results).

inScope: Help & Resources tab in global navigation
Search bar: placeholder text, keyword search, Search button, suggested keywords
Category tabs: Categories, FAQs, Contact - tab switching without page reload
Categories view: Best Practices, Product Management, GenAI Features, Compliance & Approvals cards
Category cards: icon, name, article count
Expandable article list within categories: title, summary, publish date, read time
Article card click opens full article page (link validation)
FAQs view: FAQ categories (Account & Registration, Product Listings, GenAI Assistance, Review and Ratings, Technical Support)
FAQ items: collapsible/expandable behavior, default collapsed state
Contact view: Email Support with address, Phone Support with hours and number
Unified search: categorized results (FAQs, Guides, Articles) with result counts
outOfScope: Full article page content and rendering (link validation only)
Video captioning and transcript content creation
FAQs display only admin-published content (requires admin-side setup)
Notifications for new FAQs or guides (requires admin to publish new content)
System unavailable error message (requires API failure simulation)

testCases.title: Verify Help & Resources tab is visible in global navigation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as an approved Assistive Partner
steps: 1. Log in as an approved Assistive Partner
2. Verify the 'Help & Resources' tab is visible in the top navigation bar
3. Click on the 'Help & Resources' tab
4. Verify the page redirects to the Help & Resources landing page
5. Verify the page loads without errors
expectedResults: 'Help & Resources' tab is visible in the global navigation
Clicking the tab navigates to the Help & Resources landing page
Page loads without console errors or broken UI
testCases.postconditions: User is on the Help & Resources landing page

testCases.title: Verify search bar displays with correct placeholder text
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Help & Resources landing page
steps: 1. Navigate to Help & Resources page
2. Verify a search bar is displayed at the top of the page
3. Verify the placeholder text reads: 'Search articles, FAQs, or guides…'
4. Verify a 'Search' button is present next to the search input
expectedResults: Search bar is prominently displayed at the top
Placeholder text matches: 'Search articles, FAQs, or guides…'
'Search' button is visible and clickable
testCases.postconditions: Search bar is ready for input

testCases.title: Verify search returns filtered results matching the query
testCases.preconditions: Help & Resources page has articles and FAQs available
steps: 1. Navigate to Help & Resources page
2. Type a keyword in the search bar (e.g., 'product upload')
3. Click the 'Search' button
4. Verify filtered results are displayed matching the query
5. Verify results are categorized as 'FAQs', 'Guides', or 'Articles'
6. Verify result count is displayed (e.g., 'Found 12 articles and 19 FAQs')
7. Verify results populate on the screen as per Figma design
expectedResults: Search returns results matching the keyword
Results are categorized (FAQs, Guides, Articles)
Result count is displayed accurately
Results are displayed on the page without navigation

testCases.title: Verify suggested keywords appear below search input
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Help & Resources page
steps: 1. Navigate to Help & Resources page
2. Click on the search bar or start typing
3. Verify suggested keywords appear below the search input
4. Verify suggestions include relevant terms (e.g., 'product upload', 'GenAI features', 'accessibility compliance')
5. Click on a suggested keyword
6. Verify the search is triggered with the selected keyword
expectedResults: Suggested keywords appear below the search input
Suggestions are relevant to the platform content
Clicking a suggestion triggers a search with that keyword
testCases.postconditions: Search is executed with the suggested keyword

testCases.title: Verify search with no matching results shows appropriate message
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Help & Resources page
steps: 1. Navigate to Help & Resources page
2. Type a keyword that has no matching content (e.g., 'xyznonexistent123')
3. Click the 'Search' button
4. Verify the message: 'No results found. Please try a different keyword or contact support.' is displayed
5. Verify no broken UI or empty containers are shown
expectedResults: No results message is displayed clearly
Message text matches: 'No results found. Please try a different keyword or contact support.'
UI remains clean with no broken elements
testCases.postconditions: Empty search state is handled gracefully

testCases.title: Verify category tabs (Categories, FAQs, Contact) switch content without page reload
testCases.preconditions: User is on the Help & Resources landing page
steps: 1. Navigate to Help & Resources page
2. Verify three tabs are visible: 'Categories', 'FAQs', 'Contact'
3. Click on 'Categories' tab
4. Verify the Categories content area loads
5. Click on 'FAQs' tab
6. Verify the FAQs content area loads without page navigation
7. Click on 'Contact' tab
8. Verify the Contact content area loads without page navigation
9. Verify the URL does not change when switching tabs
expectedResults: All three tabs (Categories, FAQs, Contact) are visible
Selecting a tab updates the content area dynamically
No full page reload occurs when switching tabs
Active tab is visually highlighted

testCases.title: Verify Categories view displays all four category cards with correct data

steps: 1. Navigate to Help & Resources page
2. Select the 'Categories' tab
3. Verify four category cards are displayed:
a. Best Practices

c. GenAI Features
d. Compliance & Approvals

a. Category icon
b. Category name

testCases.title: Verify clicking a category card opens expandable article list
testCases.preconditions: Categories tab is selected with category cards visible
steps: 1. Click on the 'Best Practices' category card
2. Verify an expandable container opens below the cards
3. Verify the container displays a list of articles
4. Verify each article card shows:
a. Title
b. Summary
c. Publish date
d. Estimated read time
5. Click on a different category card (e.g., 'Product Management')
6. Verify the article list updates to show articles from the new category
expectedResults: Clicking a category opens an expandable article list below the cards
Article cards display title, summary, publish date, and read time
Switching categories updates the article list
Expansion/collapse animation is smooth

testCases.title: Verify clicking an article card links to the full article page

2. Click on an article card
3. Verify the click navigates to the full article page
4. Verify the article page URL is valid

expectedResults: Clicking an article card navigates to the full article page

testCases.title: Verify category with zero articles shows appropriate state

2. Locate a category card with 0 articles (if exists)

4. Verify an appropriate empty state message is shown
5. Verify no broken UI or empty containers

Clicking shows an empty state message or no expandable list
UI handles zero-article state gracefully

steps: 1. Navigate to Help & Resources page
2. Select the 'FAQs' tab
3. Verify FAQ categories are displayed:
a. Account & Registration
b. Product Listings
c. GenAI Assistance
d. Review and Ratings
e. Technical Support
4. Verify FAQ items are listed under each category
5. Verify all FAQ items are in collapsed state by default
expectedResults: All five FAQ categories are displayed
FAQ items are listed under their respective categories

testCases.title: Verify FAQ items expand to show answer on click and collapse on re-click
testCases.preconditions: FAQs tab is selected with FAQ items visible
steps: 1. Locate a collapsed FAQ item
2. Click on the FAQ item
3. Verify the item expands to show the answer text
4. Verify the expand animation is smooth
5. Click on the same FAQ item again
6. Verify the item collapses back to show only the question
7. Verify the collapse animation is smooth
expectedResults: Clicking a collapsed FAQ expands it to show the answer
Clicking an expanded FAQ collapses it
Expand/collapse transitions are smooth
Answer text is fully readable when expanded

testCases.title: Verify multiple FAQ items can be expanded simultaneously
testCases.preconditions: FAQs tab is selected with multiple FAQ items
steps: 1. Click on the first FAQ item to expand it
2. Verify it expands
3. Click on a second FAQ item
4. Verify the second item expands
5. Verify the first item remains expanded (or collapses based on UI design)
6. Verify the behavior is consistent with the Figma design
expectedResults: Multiple FAQ items can be expanded at the same time (or accordion behavior per design)
Behavior is consistent with the Figma design specification

expectedResults: Search returns results from all resource types

Result count is displayed with the search term
Results populate on the screen as per Figma design

2. Click 'Search'
3. Verify no script execution or XSS vulnerability
4. Verify the search handles the input gracefully
5. Type other special characters (e.g., '!@#$%^&*()')
6. Verify no errors or broken UI
expectedResults: Special characters are handled safely (no XSS)
Search returns 'No results found' or handles gracefully
No console errors or broken UI elements

testCases.preconditions: User is on Help & Resources page

3. Verify either no search is triggered or a validation message appears

Whitespace-only input is handled the same as empty
